bio: I build Generative AI, RAG, and data engineering systems that turn enterprise data into decisions people can trust. At Hansvonlehwalt, I build agentic AI and RAG pipelines on Azure OpenAI for enterprise knowledge retrieval. At Tata Consultancy Services, I engineered data and ML pipelines on Azure Databricks processing 500GB+ of enterprise data daily across 1M+ validated records.
summary: AI/ML Engineer and Data Engineer with close to three years of industry experience building machine learning, Generative AI, NLP and data solutions using Python, LLMs, RAG, Azure, Databricks and cloud-native engineering. Hands-on experience with agentic and multi-agent AI workflows, semantic search, conversational AI, transformer models, REST APIs, microservices, model serving, MLOps and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines. Experienced with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Redis, monitoring and secure enterprise AI patterns, alongside a strong foundation in PySpark, SQL, statistics and predictive modelling.
obsession: Currently, I'm obsessed with making LLM systems boring in the best way — grounded, observable, and reliable enough to trust in production, not just a demo.
